title: Mayor of San Miguel Yogovana, Oaxaca, Assassinated Amid Rising Political Violence
detail: Eduardo Saavedra López, constitutional municipal mayor of San Miguel Yogovana in Oaxaca's Sierra Sur, was shot and killed outside his home in the early hours of July 12 while conducting a community surveillance patrol with municipal police. After flagging two motorcycles parked outside a residence, armed men emerged and opened fire, killing him at the scene. Oaxaca state prosecutors detained a suspect on July 14. Saavedra's death brought the 2026 total to seven sitting or former municipal mayors killed nationwide and at least 28 politicians and political-family members killed in 33 violent incidents, with Guerrero, Oaxaca, and Morelos the hardest-hit states — underscoring the persistence of narco-political violence against local officials regardless of party, a pattern that has recurred across PRI, PAN, and Morena governments.

media.caption: Mayor Eduardo Saavedra López of San Miguel Yogovana, Oaxaca, killed during an early-morning patrol, July 12, 2026
